methodology.Revenue: The 5% of swap fees burned as RUNE (value to all RUNE holders) plus protocol-kept income (outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees, developer fund and marketing fund). The node-bonder share of swap fees is treated as a security cost and the LP, affiliate and TCY shares as supplier payments, so none of those count as revenue.

methodology.Fees: Sum of (a) borrower interest accrued across every Lend reserve, (b) leverage trading fees from LeverageRfqEngine open/close/collateral-swap events, and (c) RFQ liquidation fees from RfqEngine.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue. Leverage and liquidation fees both end up at 0x1118e1c057211306a40A4d7006C040dbfE1370Cb (treasury).
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Borrower interest only. The on chain reserves accumulator collects interest, the protocol then swaps it to FT on the open market via LendEpochSettlerOperator and distributes the FT back to lenders pro rata via PositionsManager.settleEpoch. FT has a fixed total supply so nothing is minted.

Fees.RFQ Liquidation Fee: amount field of RfqEngine.LiquidationFeeCollected events, denominated in the asset being liquidated.

methodology.Fees: 3F charges two fees on its leveraged RWA positions. The performance fee is taken on the return of the leveraged collateral, after subtracting the cost of the borrowed debt. The management fee is taken on the full value of the RWA collateral, including the leveraged portion, rather than only the user's deposited capital. Fees are accrued and collected when positions are updated, so a single day can include fees that built up over the preceding days or weeks.

methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Both the management and performance fees are paid to the protocol, so protocol revenue equals the total fees collected.

Not all TeraSwap volume reaches that contract: routes filled by 0x, CoW Swap and Bebop collect the identical 0.1% through those venues' own partner-fee parameters instead of the FeeCollector, emit no SwapWithFee event, and are therefore NOT counted here.

Fees.x402 Call Fees: Per-call x402 payments by AI agents for MCP yield data, routing and execution-quote tools.

Revenue.x402 Call Fees: All x402 call fees paid by AI agents are kept by the protocol.

methodology.UserFees: Swap fees paid by traders, borrow interest paid by borrowers into LP reserves, and protocol-retained lending fees paid by borrowers and over-repayers.
methodology.Fees: Swap fees inferred from each swap's actual input minus the no-fee input required by the pre-swap reserve invariant for the observed output, the LP reserve-growth portion of borrow interest emitted by InterestAccrued, and protocol-retained lending fees minted to the Ammalgam fee recipient. Ammalgam swap fees are dynamic; see https://docs.ammalgam.xyz/docs/developer-guide/contracts/libraries/QuadraticSwapFees.
methodology.Revenue: Protocol-retained lending fees minted to the Ammalgam fee recipient. No protocol fees are taken from swaps.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol-retained lending fees minted to the Ammalgam fee recipient. No protocol fees are taken from swaps.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Swap fees and the LP reserve-growth portion of borrow interest accrue to liquidity providers.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume from Ammalgam pairs deployed by the Ethereum mainnet factory. Volume is counted from the input side of each Swap event only: amountXIn for tokenX and amountYIn for tokenY.

Volume.Swap Volume: Input-side token amounts from Ammalgam Swap events.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Input-token fees inferred from actual input less no-fee invariant input. Ammalgam swap fees are dynamic: https://docs.ammalgam.xyz/docs/developer-guide/contracts/libraries/QuadraticSwapFees.
Fees.Borrow Interest: LP share of borrow interest inferred from each InterestAccrued event's post-interest reserves minus the tracked pre-interest raw reserves.
Fees.Initial Lending Fees: Initial lending fees charged when users borrow token X, token Y, or liquidity from Ammalgam pairs.
Fees.Protocol Interest Fees: Protocol share of lending interest accrued by Ammalgam pairs.
Fees.Over-Repay Fees: Over-repay amounts retained by the protocol when repayment exceeds the outstanding debt.
Fees.Unclassified Protocol Fees: Protocol fee mints whose transaction source event was unavailable in the adapter log window.

UserFees.Borrow Interest: Borrow interest paid by borrowers into LP reserves.
UserFees.Initial Lending Fees: Initial lending fees charged when users borrow token X, token Y, or liquidity from Ammalgam pairs.
UserFees.Protocol Interest Fees: Protocol share of lending interest accrued by Ammalgam pairs.
UserFees.Over-Repay Fees: Over-repay amounts retained by the protocol when repayment exceeds the outstanding debt.
UserFees.Unclassified Protocol Fees: Protocol fee mints whose transaction source event was unavailable in the adapter log window.

Revenue.Initial Lending Fees To Fee Recipient: Initial lending fees minted to the Ammalgam factory fee recipient.
Revenue.Protocol Interest Fees To Fee Recipient: Protocol interest fees minted to the Ammalgam factory fee recipient.
Revenue.Over-Repay Fees To Fee Recipient: Over-repay fees minted to the Ammalgam factory fee recipient.
Revenue.Unclassified Protocol Fees To Fee Recipi: Protocol fee mints to the Ammalgam factory fee recipient whose transaction source event was unavailable in the adapter log window.

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: Swap fees accruing to liquidity providers. No protocol fees are taken from swaps.
SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest To LPs: LP reserve-growth portion of borrow interest accruing to liquidity providers.

ProtocolRevenue.Initial Lending Fees To Fee Recipient: Initial lending fees minted to the Ammalgam factory fee recipient.
ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Interest Fees To Fee Recipient: Protocol interest fees minted to the Ammalgam factory fee recipient.
ProtocolRevenue.Over-Repay Fees To Fee Recipient: Over-repay fees minted to the Ammalgam factory fee recipient.
ProtocolRevenue.Unclassified Protocol Fees To Fee Recipi: Protocol fee mints to the Ammalgam factory fee recipient whose transaction source event was unavailable in the adapter log window.

methodology.Volume: Gross ETH paid by purchasers for acquisitions (pulls), net of refunded, expired, or slippage-cancelled requests.
methodology.Fees: Net Acquisition fees paid by NFT purchasers, plus settlement fees taken from listing backings.
methodology.Revenue: Team share of the protocol's cut of acquisition and settlement fees, plus any fees diverted to FWA-token buybacks.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Team share of the protocol's fee cut, per the Splitter contract's live split.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: FWA-token buybacks funded from protocol fees, plus retroactive scheduled buybacks funded from previously earned team fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Share of net acquisition fees distributed to NFT depositors (equal split across active listings plus the top-listing pot), plus the snapshot soulbound-NFT holders' share of protocol fees via the Splitter.

Fees.Acquisition Fees: The total ETH paid by purchasers to acquire a random NFT from the pool, net of refunded requests and of quick-sell payouts returned to purchasers (85% of the listing backing when they accept the depositor's standing bid).
Fees.Settlement Fees: 1% of the listing backing, charged when a settlement returns the backing to the depositor (purchaser keeps or relists the NFT).
Fees.Retained Settlement Penalties: 15% of the listing backing retained when a purchaser accepts the depositor's standing bid instead of keeping the NFT.

Revenue.Settlement Fees: Settlement fees accrue entirely to the protocol.
Revenue.Retained Settlement Penalties: Retained settlement penalties accrue to the protocol.
Revenue.Token Buy Back: Protocol fees diverted to FWA-token buybacks.

SupplySideRevenue.Acquisition Fees: Share of net acquisition fees distributed to NFT depositors, split equally across active listings.
SupplySideRevenue.Top Listing Reward: Share of acquisition fees accruing to the depositor of the top-backed listing.
SupplySideRevenue.Acquisition Fees to Snapshot NFT Holders: Snapshot soulbound-NFT holders' share (via the Splitter) of the protocol's cut of acquisition fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Settlement Fees to Snapshot NFT Holders: Snapshot soulbound-NFT holders' share (via the Splitter) of settlement fees.
SupplySideRevenue.Retained Settlement Penalties to Snapsho: Snapshot soulbound-NFT holders' share (via the Splitter) of retained settlement penalties.
SupplySideRevenue.Retained Settlement Penalties: Settlement discount redistributed among active NFT depositors.

ProtocolRevenue.Settlement Fees: Settlement fees accrue entirely to the protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Retained Settlement Penalties: Retained settlement penalties accrue to the protocol.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Protocol fees diverted to FWA-token buybacks.
HoldersRevenue.Retroactive buybacks: Scheduled FWA-token buybacks (327 ETH in 1 ETH slices every 2 hours) funded from previously earned team fees.

methodology.Volume: Swap volume is back-calculated from fees received by the Yieldzio fee wallet. The standard fees use a 0.02% rate ($1 per $5,000). AVLT fees on Ethereum and HyperEVM use a 0.1% rate ($1 of fees per $1,000 of volume) due to the majority of the AVLT volume coming from the liquidation service which charges a 10bps fee.
methodology.Fees: All ERC-20 payments (0.1% swap fees on AVLT volume, 0.02% on other volume) received by the Yieldzio fee wallet are counted as fees.
methodology.UserFees: Yieldzio charges 0.1% (10 bps) on AVLT volume on Ethereum and HyperEVM, and 0.02% (2 bps) on other volume.
methodology.Revenue: 100% of fees (0.1% swap fees on AVLT volume, 0.02% on other volume) received by the fee wallet are protocol revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 100% of fees (0.1% swap fees on AVLT volume, 0.02% on other volume) received by the fee wallet are protocol revenue.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: Yieldzio charges 0.1% (10 bps) on AVLT volume on Ethereum and HyperEVM, and 0.02% (2 bps) on other volume.

UserFees.Token Swap Fees: Yieldzio charges 0.1% (10 bps) on AVLT volume on Ethereum and HyperEVM, and 0.02% (2 bps) on other volume.

Revenue.Token Swap Fees: Yieldzio charges 0.1% (10 bps) on AVLT volume on Ethereum and HyperEVM, and 0.02% (2 bps) on other volume.

ProtocolRevenue.Token Swap Fees: Yieldzio charges 0.1% (10 bps) on AVLT volume on Ethereum and HyperEVM, and 0.02% (2 bps) on other volume.

methodology.Fees: Redemption fees, management fees, performance fees, and elUSD yield distributed to stakers.
methodology.UserFees: Redemption fees, management fees, and performance fees paid by users.
methodology.Revenue: Redemption fees retained by the treasury wallet, management fees accrued by the vault, and performance fees collected by the vault.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Redemption, management, and performance fees allocated to the protocol.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: elUSD yield minted to the staking contract during NAV syncs.

Fees.Mint/Redeem Fees: Redemption fees computed from emitted redemption data, oracle pricing, token config, and the active redemption fee rate.
Fees.Management Fees: Management fees computed from ManagementFeeAccrued using gross NAV, elapsed time, and the active management fee rate.
Fees.Performance Fees: Performance fees emitted by FeesCollected in USD 1e18 precision.
Fees.Assets Yields: elUSD yield minted to the staking contract.

UserFees.Mint/Redeem Fees: Fees paid directly by users when redeeming elUSD.
UserFees.Management Fees: Management fees charged to vault users.
UserFees.Performance Fees: Performance fees charged on vault performance.

Revenue.Redeem Fees To Treasury: Redeem fees retained by the Elara treasury.
Revenue.Management Fees To Treasury: Management fees collected by the Elara vault.
Revenue.Performance Fees To Treasury: Performance fees collected by the Elara vault.

ProtocolRevenue.Redeem Fees To Treasury: Redeem fees allocated to the Elara treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Management Fees To Treasury: Management fees allocated to the protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Performance Fees To Treasury: Performance fees allocated to the protocol.

methodology.Fees: Transfer tax (0.95% default, higher during the anti-whale decay window after launch) charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens, valued in WETH at the launch pair spot rate. The Uniswap v2 pair fee is not counted.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees: the transfer tax is paid by token senders.
methodology.Revenue: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps of the 95bps tax, 30bps when a referrer is set), split 10% treasury / 90% governance. Revenue from non-Ethereum chains is bridged weekly to Ethereum, where the split applies (net of bridge fees).
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The treasury 10% of the Boardwalk share, plus governance epoch budgets that weekly votes direct to the treasury or into permanently locked protocol-owned BWLK/ETH liquidity (recognized when the epoch executes on Ethereum).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: The portion of the governance 90% recognized when each weekly epoch executes on Ethereum with a holder-accruing outcome chosen by sbfBWLK-weighted votes: BWLK buyback-and-burn or distribution to voters.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Tax shares accruing to launch issuers, stakers of the launch Uniswap v2 LP, referrers and integrators.

Fees.Token Tax: Transfer tax charged on every non-exempt transfer of Boardwalk-launched tokens.

UserFees.Token Tax: Transfer tax paid by token senders.

Revenue.Token Tax To Protocol: Boardwalk's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps, 30bps when a referrer is set).

ProtocolRevenue.Token Tax To Treasury: 10% of the Boardwalk share, forwarded to the treasury (BoardwalkFeeCollector.GOVERNANCE_BPS).
ProtocolRevenue.Governance Epochs To Treasury: Weekly governance epoch budgets whose winning vote (or forced fallback) sends the WETH to the treasury.
ProtocolRevenue.Locked BWLK Liquidity: Epoch budgets used to buy BWLK and mint permanently locked protocol-owned BWLK/ETH liquidity.

HoldersRevenue.BWLK Buyback Burns: Epoch budgets swapped to BWLK and burned to the dead address.
HoldersRevenue.Voter Distributions: Epoch budgets swapped to BWLK and streamed to the epoch's voters.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Creators: Launch issuer's share of the transfer tax (default 35bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To LP Stakers: Share streamed to stakers of the launch Uniswap v2 LP via LPStaking fee epochs (default 15bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Referrers: Referrer's share, carved out of the Boardwalk share on Advanced launches (up to 5bps).
SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax To Integrators: Share split across the five integrator slots (10bps total).

methodology.Volume: Gross sell-token amounts routed through HojswapRouterV2, read from its SwapExecuted events. Underlying DEX volume is not attributed as House of Joshi liquidity.
methodology.Fees: The 1% House fee paid by users on swaps executed through HojswapRouterV2, using the exact feeAmount emitted for each trade.
methodology.Revenue: All House swap fees are retained by the protocol; there is no supply-side fee allocation.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All the House swap fees are retained by the protocol.

Fees.Swap Fees: The feeAmount emitted by HojswapRouterV2 for each completed swap.

Revenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The full House fee sent to the protocol's configured House wallet.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees To Protocol: The full House fee retained by the protocol.

methodology.Fees: 0.3% Uniswap V2 swap fee on the WISE/ETH pair.
methodology.Revenue: The pool is ownerless (no admin/team fee switch), so no portion of swap fees is retained as protocol revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Gets management + performance fees
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The pool is ownerless (no admin/team fee switch), so 100% of swap fees accrue to LPs, growing the pool reserves that back WISE.
methodology.Volume: Swap volume (both sides) on the WISE/ETH Uniswap V2 pair.

Fees.Token Swap Fees: 0.3% Uniswap V2 swap fee on the WISE/ETH pair.

SupplySideRevenue.LP Fees: All swap fees accrue to LPs; the pool has LP tokens burned to divert a protocol cut.

methodology.Volume: USDC notional of swaps routed through LyraSwapRouter into Uniswap v2/v3/v4 pools, reconstructed from each InterfaceFeeCollected event by dividing the collected fee by the fee rate in effect at that block. The fee is charged on the gross USDC leg of every trade, so this reproduces the traded notional exactly. As with any aggregator, this volume also executes on Uniswap and is counted there under Uniswap's own adapter.
methodology.Fees: The interface fee LyraSwapRouter charges on the USDC leg of each routed swap (0.20% since deploy), taken from the InterfaceFeeCollected event. Uniswap's LP fee is excluded — it is paid to Uniswap LPs and Lyra cannot capture it.
methodology.Revenue: Equal to fees (0.20% of the swap's notional value). There is no supply side: Lyra provides no liquidity for this product, so nothing is shared with LPs.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All interface fees (0.20% of the swap's notional value) are sent to the Lyra fee collector. No token exists and no share is paid to holders.
methodology.UserFees: The full interface fee is paid by the trader on each swap.

Fees.Trading Fees: 0.20% interface fee on the USDC leg of each swap routed through LyraSwapRouter.

Revenue.Trading Fees: The interface fee (0.20% of the swap's notional value) is retained in full — no liquidity providers to share it with.

ProtocolRevenue.Trading Fees: Interface fees (0.20% of the swap's notional value) accrue to the Lyra fee collector.

UserFees.Trading Fees: Interface fee (0.20% of the swap's notional value) paid by the trader on each swap.

methodology.Revenue: All fees collected go to Immunefi.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All fees collected go to Immunefi.

ProtocolRevenue.Submission & Verification fees: Fees paid by security researchers to submit bug reports to pay-to-submit programs and to complete identity verification, collected by Immunefi.

methodology.Volume: Input value of every order placed on the Hyperbridge IntentGateway (same-chain and cross-chain), counted on the source chain.
methodology.Fees: 0.05% protocol fee deducted from order inputs at placement.
methodology.Revenue: The 0.05% protocol fee, retained by the gateway.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The 0.05% protocol fee, retained by the gateway.

Fees.Protocol Fees: 0.05% of each order input, deducted at placement (DustCollected events in placement txs).

Revenue.Protocol Fees To Treasury: Protocol fee retained by the gateway, swept by governance.

ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Fees To Treasury: Protocol fee retained by the gateway, swept by governance.

methodology.Fees: XAGm custody fees and redemption fees.
methodology.Revenue: XAGm custody and redemption fees accounted as protocol revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: XAGm custody and redemption fees accounted as protocol revenue.

Fees.Management Fees: XAGm custody fees from Ethereum ReconcileSupply events, which mint fee tokens covering the global token obligation across all chains.
Fees.Mint/Redeem Fees: 0.50% fee charged on XAGm redemption orders from Matrixdock mint/redeem transparency records.

Revenue.Management Fees: XAGm custody fees accounted as protocol revenue.
Revenue.Mint/Redeem Fees: XAGm redemption fee accounted as protocol revenue.

ProtocolRevenue.Management Fees: XAGm custody fees accounted as protocol revenue.
ProtocolRevenue.Mint/Redeem Fees: XAGm redemption fee accounted as protocol revenue.

methodology.Revenue: Yields are collected by curators.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Yields are collected by curators.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Yields are distributed to vaults depositors/investors.

Revenue.Kamino Management Fees: Management fees charged from Kamino kvaults

methodology.Volume: Pennysia-routed volume only (not inner DEX swaps): sell-token input from SwapExecuted on Settlement (SYNC and SODAX opens), CoW Trade.sellAmount when the order's appData partnerFee.recipient is the Settlement fee recipient, Velora Delta OrderSettled.srcAmount when a partner-fee Transfer hits that recipient, and UniswapX Fill output inferred as that fee × 10000 / 50.
methodology.Fees: Settlement FeeCollected (SYNC surplus capped at 10% of gross, leftover token/ETH sweeps, and gas markup on extra executeSwap msg.value); CoW partner fee on executed buy at the order's partner bps (CIP-75: 75% protocol / 25% CoW); Velora OrderSettled.partnerFee or the matched Transfer; UniswapX fee-output Transfer. No FeeCollected on SODAX intent opens.
methodology.Revenue: Pennysia retains 100% of Settlement FeeCollected, UniswapX fee outputs, and Velora partner fees at the Settlement fee recipient. CoW protocol revenue is 75% of the partner fee; CIP-75's 25% is supply-side.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All retained amounts go to the Settlement fee recipient, except CoW's 25% service fee.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Partner Fees for CoW: CIP-75 service fee (~25% of the partner fee) withheld by CoW Swap on Pennysia-tagged trades. UniswapX and Velora partner fees are paid in full to Pennysia.

Fees.Settlement Fees: FeeCollected on Settlement: surplus above the quoted output (capped at 10% of gross), leftover token/ETH sweeps, and gas markup (extra ETH on executeSwap msg.value). ETH↔WETH wrap/unwrap leftover is transferred without FeeCollected and is not in this bucket.
Fees.Intent Fees: CoW: partner bps on executed buy from appData (tagged by Settlement feeRecipient). UniswapX / Velora: matched partner-fee Transfer (or Velora OrderSettled.partnerFee) in the fill transaction.

Revenue.Settlement Fees: Pennysia retains 100% of FeeCollected (surplus, leftover sweeps, and gas markup).
Revenue.Intent Fees: UniswapX / Velora: 100% of the fill-tx partner fee. CoW: 75% after CIP-75.

ProtocolRevenue.Settlement Fees: Collected amounts are sent to the Settlement fee recipient.
ProtocolRevenue.Intent Fees: Matched hard-intent partner fees except CoW's 25% service fee.

SupplySideRevenue.Partner Fees for CoW: Service fee from partner integrations (~25% on average). CIP-75 withholds this share of the CoW partner fee before payout to Pennysia.

methodology.Fees: 0.35% redeem fee on private transfers (withheld from the gross amount before zAssets are minted to the recipient, live since 2026-06-02) plus liquidity-based unwrap fees charged by the LiquidityManagers.
methodology.Revenue: All fees (redeem and unwrap) are retained by the protocol: the redeem fee is never minted, and unwrap fees accrue to the LiquidityManager fee surplus.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: All fees (redeem and unwrap) are retained by the protocol.

Fees.Redeem Fees: 0.35% of the gross private-transfer amount, derived from Teleport mints as minted * 0.35 / 99.65.
Fees.Unwrap Fees: feeAmount from LiquidityManager Unwrapped events; the rate rises as liquidity falls below target (zBNB is exempt).

Revenue.Redeem Fees: Redeem fee withheld by the protocol.
Revenue.Unwrap Fees: Unwrap fees added to the LiquidityManager fee surplus.

ProtocolRevenue.Redeem Fees: Redeem fee withheld by the protocol.
ProtocolRevenue.Unwrap Fees: Unwrap fees added to the LiquidityManager fee surplus.

methodology.Fees: Total ETH gas fees (base fees + priority fees) plus blob fees (post-EIP-4844, type-3 blob-carrying transactions) paid by users
methodology.Revenue: Amount of ETH burned — base fees plus blob fees (both are permanently burned, accruing to no proposer)
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Amount of ETH burned — base fees plus blob fees

Fees.Transaction Base Fees: Total ETH base fees paid by users
Fees.Transaction Priority Fees: Total ETH priority fees paid by users
Fees.Transaction Blob Fees: Total ETH blob fees paid by users on type-3 transactions (EIP-4844, live since 2024-03-13)

methodology.Fees: Includes yields on all vaults and management fees (0.50% p.a. on total collateral).
methodology.Revenue: Management fees (0.50% p.a.): Advisor 0.10% + Platform 0.20% + Liquidity 0.20%, applied to total collateral value.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue - management fees collected by OpenTrade protocol.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Net yield distributed to vault depositors after protocol fees.

Fees.Assets Yields: Yields on vaults distributed to depositors.
Fees.Management Fees: Management fees (0.50% p.a.) applied to total collateral value.

Revenue.Management Fees: Management fees (0.50% p.a.) applied to total collateral value.

SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields: Yields on vaults distributed to depositors.

ProtocolRevenue.Management Fees: Management fees going to protocol treasury.
